items.question: How do I buy the coffee?
items.answer: Follow Lucia to the motel kitchen, then use the coffee machine to buy the $2 coffee.

sources.at: Go to the motel kitchen with Lucia; Buy Lucia a coffee

items.question: How do I switch between Jason and Lucia?
items.answer: Coffee Break unlocks free character switching. Hold D-pad Right to open the partner controls.

sources.at: Hold D-Pad Right to interact with your partner

items.question: What makes the move become available?
items.answer: Reach $15,000 and finish the available main missions listed under Map > Story. Then watch for the objective marker on your Starlet Motel room.

sources.at: Earn more money by partnering up (at least $15,000)

items.question: Where do I start Checking Out?
items.answer: After the partner call, return to your marked Starlet Motel room and interact with the bathroom door. Starting this mission ends your stay at the motel.

sources.at: Starting Location: Checking Out (Move to Vice City); Point of No Return

items.question: How does this mission start?
items.answer: Finish Checking Out. Welcome to Vice City begins automatically as you enter Chapter 3.

sources.at: Starting Location: Welcome to Vice City

items.question: Where do I wait at the café?
items.answer: After VCIA Takedown, wait for Yasmani to contact you. At Café Orquidea in Ocean Beach, sit by the window to watch for the security van.

sources.at: Starting Location: That’s Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe); quest description

items.question: How do I follow the van?
items.answer: Keep some distance while following the security van. When it parks, follow the guard into the bank.

sources.at: Tail the security van; Tail the guard

items.question: Can I rent a car for the first race?
items.answer: Yes. The meetup offers three rental cars costing $600–$900. PowerPyx found the most expensive option had the strongest stats.

sources.at: Select a vehicle

items.question: What opens the locked Balsero lab?
items.answer: For the second Balsero location in PowerPyx’s list, use 1999 on the garage keypad. The same code appears on a nearby billboard.

sources.at: Balsero Labs, Location #2

items.question: Can I leave the labs until after the story?
items.answer: Yes. PowerPyx confirms the labs remain available in free roam after the campaign. You can also discover them without waiting for a contact to supply each location.

sources.at: Introduction: obtaining locations and post-story availability

items.question: How do I open the hatch inside the motel?
items.answer: Inspect the wooden floor hatch behind the downstairs green door. Get the key from the clerk upstairs, then return to the hatch.

sources.at: Find the synthetics lab in the motel; Get back to Tyrone/Loot the clerk; Break into the lab

items.question: Which safe code belongs to each shop?
items.answer: Casa de Empeno uses 1680; Richardson Jewelry uses 6815; Donovan Banks & Co. uses 0104. Check the shop name before trying a code.

sources.at: Hit Casa De Empeno; Hit Richardson Jewelry; Hit Donovan Banks & Co.

items.question: How do I get the Snap Gun before the other robberies?
items.answer: Deliver the first requested item to Yasmani. He gives you the Snap Gun, which opens the other shops’ rear entrances without setting off their door alarms.

sources.at: Starting Location: Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs; Hit Richardson Jewelry; Hit Donovan Banks & Co.

items.question: Which upgrades does Yago want?
items.answer: Choose Pro Builds > Full Kits > Custom Street Racing Build, then Performance > Boost > Nitrous Boost. Yago covers these upgrades.

sources.at: Apply the pro build / Apply the nitrous boost

items.question: What do I do after the race?
items.answer: Lose the police first. The next meetup marker then appears in northern Vice City; drive there to finish the job.

sources.at: Lose the cops; Drive to the meetup

items.question: How do I open the jewelry-store safe?
items.answer: The safe is in the back. You can use an explosive, or wait for Billy to obtain the code from the staff.

sources.at: Enter the jewelry store / Rob the jewelry store

items.question: How can I leave the rooftop without paying?
items.answer: Ride the bicycle up the solar panels at speed to jump onto the neighboring roof. Use the elevator there to get down.

sources.at: Ending 2: Don’t pay $50,000
